panels.description: Míra zmetkovitosti v % (určuje barvu ručičky dle cíle NNJ 2.89%). V závorce je uveden absolutní počet zmetků v kusech za zvolené období.
panels.title: Kvalita: Zmetkovitost NNJ (%) a [ks]

targets.query:
scraps = from(bucket: "production_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "injection_molding" and r._field == "is_scrap")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine_id == "LIS-201" or r.machine_id == "LIS-208" or r.machine_id == "LIS-305" or r.machine_id == "LAK-FLAT-01")
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id", "machine_name"])
  |> sum()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "scrap_count")

pct = from(bucket: "production_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "injection_molding" and r._field == "is_scrap")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine_id == "LIS-201" or r.machine_id == "LIS-208" or r.machine_id == "LIS-305" or r.machine_id == "LAK-FLAT-01")
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id", "machine_name"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 100.0}))

join(tables: {s: scraps, p: pct}, on: ["machine_id", "machine_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time_p,
      _value: r._value_p,
      _field: "zmetkovitost",
      machine_id: r.machine_id,
      machine_name: r.machine_name,
      scrap_count: string(v: r._value_s)
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id", "machine_name", "scrap_count"])

panels.description: Finanční míra nejakosti v % z celkových výrobních nákladů. Barva: Zelená < 2.5%, Žlutá do 3.5%, Červená > 3.5% (cíl Plastiky 2.89%). V závorce je celková ztráta v Kč.
panels.title: Finanční NNJ (%) dle linek

targets.query:
total_czk = from(bucket: "production_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "injection_molding" and r._field == "scrap_cost_czk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine_id == "LIS-201" or r.machine_id == "LIS-208" or r.machine_id == "LIS-305" or r.machine_id == "LAK-FLAT-01")
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id", "machine_name"])
  |> sum()

total_cycles = from(bucket: "production_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "injection_molding" and r._field == "is_scrap")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine_id == "LIS-201" or r.machine_id == "LIS-208" or r.machine_id == "LIS-305" or r.machine_id == "LAK-FLAT-01")
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id", "machine_name"])
  |> count()

join(tables: {czk: total_czk, cnt: total_cycles}, on: ["machine_id", "machine_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time_czk,
      machine_id: r.machine_id,
      machine_name: r.machine_name,
      _field: "nnj_pct",
      _value: (float(v: r._value_czk) / (float(v: r._value_cnt) * 65.0)) * 100.0,
      total_loss: string(v: int(v: r._value_czk))
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id", "machine_name", "total_loss", "_field"])

panels.description: Průměrná rychlost finanční ztráty za hodinu provozu v Kč/h. Barva: Zelená do 400 Kč/h, Žlutá do 800 Kč/h, Červená nad 800 Kč/h.
panels.title: Rychlost ztráty (Kč/h) dle linek
